title: Feature flag front matter
description: The front matter of one feature flag record (#4024): a workspace record one member's build reads as a build-time parameter. The file is named <id>.flag.md.

schema.description: Format version of this file. Bumped only by a change to this schema.

id.description: The flag's name, which the build records as the source flag:<id> of the parameter it sets. Lowercase, with dashes.

title.description: What the flag hides, in a few words. Optional.

owner.description: Who owns the flag, and removes it once its work is settled.

work.description: The id of the work item the flag hides, a record of the work kind the flag kind names. A work item's implements names a decision, never a flag, so the link is kept here.

member.description: The workspace member whose build parameter the flag sets, by its name in chant.workspace.json.

param.description: The build parameter the flag sets: a key of buildParams in the member's chant.config.ts. Its value per environment must have the parameter's type and, when it declares one, be in its enum.

values.description: The flag's value per environment, keyed by the environment's name. An environment left out builds with the parameter's declared default.
